---
title: "Module 0: Data Acquisition"
author: "Helen Hoxie"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Download TCGA-HNSC clinical, mRNA (STAR counts), miRNA and masked
somatic mutation data from the GDC, and restrict every layer to oral cavity
squamous cell carcinoma (OCSCC) patients, selected by tissue/organ of origin.
Each layer is downloaded only if its processed output is absent from
`data/processed/`; reused files are reported in the log.

**Inputs.** GDC API (TCGAbiolinks); `config/config.json`;
`data/external/HPV_summary_TCGA2015NatureSupp1_2.txt` (user-supplied; see README).

**Outputs** (relative to `project_dir`):

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/raw/GDCdata/` | GDC downloads |
| `data/processed/clinical_ocscc.rds` | clinical table, one row per OCSCC patient |
| `data/processed/rna_ocscc_se.rds` | SummarizedExperiment, STAR counts |
| `data/processed/rna_metadata_ocscc.rds` | barcode-to-patient map (mRNA) |
| `data/processed/mirna_ocscc_counts.rds` | miRNA count matrix (miRNA x barcode) |
| `data/processed/mirna_metadata_ocscc.rds` | barcode-to-patient map (miRNA) |
| `data/processed/OCSCC_Mutation_Details.txt` | mutation table with LoF class |

The clinical table defines the cohort. Each omics layer contains a subset of
these patients; layers differ in which patients they include, and some patients
contribute a normal adjacent tissue (NAT) sample in addition to the tumor.


```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
start_log(cfg, "Module_0_DataAcquisition")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(TCGAbiolinks)
  library(maftools)
})

gdc_dir <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "raw")
```


```{r gdc_release}
# GDC data release at run time. Applies to any layer downloaded in this run;
# layers reused from data/processed/ may come from an earlier release.
gdc_info <- tryCatch(getGDCInfo(), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(gdc_info)) {
  cat("GDC API not reachable: data release not recorded.\n")
} else {
  cat("GDC data release at run time:", gdc_info$data_release, "\n")
}
```


## 1. Clinical data and OCSCC cohort definition

```{r clinical}
# ICD-O-3 site labels as reported in GDC tissue_or_organ_of_origin.
# The list includes lip and mandible sites (see README, Cohort definition).
oral_cavity_sites <- c(
  "Tongue, NOS", "Border of tongue", "Ventral surface of tongue, NOS",
  "Floor of mouth, NOS", "Anterior floor of mouth", "Gum, NOS",
  "Lower gum", "Upper Gum", "Hard palate", "Palate, NOS",
  "Cheek mucosa", "Lip, NOS", "Retromolar area", "Mouth, NOS", "Mandible"
)

clinical_file <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "clinical_ocscc.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_file)) {
  note_existing(clinical_file)
  clinical_ocscc <- readRDS(clinical_file)
} else {
  clinical_hnsc <- GDCquery_clinic(project = "TCGA-HNSC", type = "clinical")
  clinical_ocscc <- clinical_hnsc %>%
    filter(tissue_or_organ_of_origin %in% oral_cavity_sites)
  saveRDS(clinical_ocscc, clinical_file)
  rm(clinical_hnsc)
}

# One row per patient is required downstream
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clinical_ocscc$submitter_id))
ocscc_patient_ids <- clinical_ocscc$submitter_id

cat("=== Clinical Data ===\n")
cat("Patients:", length(ocscc_patient_ids), "\n")
cat("\nAnatomical sites:\n")
print(table(clinical_ocscc$tissue_or_organ_of_origin))
cat("\nStage distribution:\n")
print(table(clinical_ocscc$ajcc_pathologic_stage, useNA = "ifany"))
```


## 2. mRNA-seq (STAR counts)

```{r mrna}
rna_se_file   <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "rna_ocscc_se.rds")
rna_meta_file <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "rna_metadata_ocscc.rds")

if (all(file.exists(c(rna_se_file, rna_meta_file)))) {
  note_existing(c(rna_se_file, rna_meta_file))
  rna_se   <- readRDS(rna_se_file)
  rna_meta <- readRDS(rna_meta_file)
} else {
  query_rna <- GDCquery(
    project       = "TCGA-HNSC",
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type     = "Gene Expression Quantification",
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
  )
  query_rna$results[[1]] <- query_rna$results[[1]] %>%
    filter(substr(cases, 1, 12) %in% ocscc_patient_ids)

  GDCdownload(query_rna, directory = gdc_dir, method = "api")
  rna_data <- GDCprepare(query = query_rna, directory = gdc_dir)

  rna_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(rna_data))
  rna_meta$barcode          <- rownames(rna_meta)
  rna_meta$patient_id       <- substr(rna_meta$barcode, 1, 12)
  rna_meta$sample_type_code <- substr(rna_meta$barcode, 14, 15)
  rna_meta <- rna_meta %>% filter(patient_id %in% ocscc_patient_ids)

  rna_se <- rna_data[, rna_meta$barcode]

  saveRDS(rna_se, rna_se_file)
  saveRDS(rna_meta, rna_meta_file)
  rm(query_rna, rna_data)
}

stopifnot(all(c("barcode", "patient_id", "sample_type_code") %in% colnames(rna_meta)))
stopifnot(all(rna_meta$barcode %in% colnames(rna_se)))
stopifnot(all(rna_meta$patient_id %in% ocscc_patient_ids))

cat("=== mRNA Data ===\n")
cat("GDC data release recorded in object:",
    if (is.null(metadata(rna_se)$data_release)) "not recorded" else metadata(rna_se)$data_release, "\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(rna_se), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(rna_se), "\n")
cat("  Tumor (01):", sum(rna_meta$sample_type_code == "01"), "\n")
cat("  Normal (11):", sum(rna_meta$sample_type_code == "11"), "\n")

paired <- rna_meta %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  filter(any(sample_type_code == "01") & any(sample_type_code == "11")) %>%
  pull(patient_id) %>% unique()
cat("  Paired (Tumor + Normal) patients:", length(paired), "\n")
```


## 3. miRNA-seq

```{r mirna}
mirna_counts_file <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "mirna_ocscc_counts.rds")
mirna_meta_file   <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "mirna_metadata_ocscc.rds")

if (all(file.exists(c(mirna_counts_file, mirna_meta_file)))) {
  note_existing(c(mirna_counts_file, mirna_meta_file))
  mirna_counts <- readRDS(mirna_counts_file)
  mirna_meta   <- readRDS(mirna_meta_file)
} else {
  query_mirna <- GDCquery(
    project       = "TCGA-HNSC",
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type     = "miRNA Expression Quantification"
  )
  query_mirna$results[[1]] <- query_mirna$results[[1]] %>%
    filter(substr(cases, 1, 12) %in% ocscc_patient_ids)

  GDCdownload(query_mirna, directory = gdc_dir)
  mirna_data <- GDCprepare(query_mirna, directory = gdc_dir)

  # GDC miRNA data is a data.frame; count columns are prefixed "read_count_"
  read_count_cols <- grep("^read_count_", colnames(mirna_data), value = TRUE)
  sample_barcodes <- gsub("^read_count_", "", read_count_cols)

  mirna_counts_all <- mirna_data[, read_count_cols]
  rownames(mirna_counts_all) <- mirna_data$miRNA_ID
  colnames(mirna_counts_all) <- sample_barcodes

  mirna_meta <- data.frame(
    barcode          = sample_barcodes,
    patient_id       = substr(sample_barcodes, 1, 12),
    sample_type_code = substr(sample_barcodes, 14, 15),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% filter(patient_id %in% ocscc_patient_ids)

  mirna_counts <- mirna_counts_all[, mirna_meta$barcode]

  saveRDS(mirna_counts, mirna_counts_file)
  saveRDS(mirna_meta, mirna_meta_file)
  rm(query_mirna, mirna_data, mirna_counts_all, read_count_cols, sample_barcodes)
}

stopifnot(all(mirna_meta$barcode %in% colnames(mirna_counts)))
stopifnot(all(mirna_meta$patient_id %in% ocscc_patient_ids))

cat("=== miRNA Data ===\n")
cat("miRNAs:", nrow(mirna_counts), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(mirna_counts), "\n")
cat("  Tumor (01):", sum(mirna_meta$sample_type_code == "01"), "\n")
cat("  Normal (11):", sum(mirna_meta$sample_type_code == "11"), "\n")
```


## 4. Somatic mutations (masked MAF)

```{r mutations}
mut_file <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "OCSCC_Mutation_Details.txt")

# Loss-of-function classes
lof_variants <- c("Nonsense_Mutation", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Splice_Site")

if (file.exists(mut_file)) {
  note_existing(mut_file)
} else {
  query_maf <- GDCquery(
    project       = "TCGA-HNSC",
    data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
    data.type     = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
    workflow.type = "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking"
  )
  GDCdownload(query_maf, method = "api", directory = gdc_dir)
  maf_raw <- GDCprepare(query_maf, directory = gdc_dir)

  maf_data <- maf_raw %>%
    filter(substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12) %in% ocscc_patient_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      Mutation_Type    = ifelse(Variant_Classification %in% lof_variants, "LoF", "Other"),
      Specific_Variant = Variant_Classification
    )

  write.table(maf_data, mut_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  rm(query_maf, maf_raw, maf_data)
}

maf_obj <- read.maf(maf = mut_file, verbose = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(substr(as.character(getSampleSummary(maf_obj)$Tumor_Sample_Barcode), 1, 12)
              %in% ocscc_patient_ids))

n_top <- 20
cat("=== Mutation Data ===\n")
cat("Samples with mutations:", nrow(getSampleSummary(maf_obj)), "\n")
cat("Total mutations:", sum(getSampleSummary(maf_obj)$total), "\n")
cat("\nTop", n_top, "mutated genes:\n")
print(getGeneSummary(maf_obj)[seq_len(n_top), c("Hugo_Symbol", "MutatedSamples")])
```


## 5. HPV status table (external input)

```{r hpv_check}
hpv_file <- proj_path(cfg, "data", "external", "HPV_summary_TCGA2015NatureSupp1_2.txt")

if (!file.exists(hpv_file)) {
  stop("HPV table not found at ", hpv_file,
       ". Download it from the supplementary information of the TCGA HNSC ",
       "publication (see README, External data).", call. = FALSE)
}

hpv_data <- read.table(hpv_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, Final_HPV_Status)

hpv_ocscc <- hpv_data %>% filter(patient_id %in% ocscc_patient_ids)

cat("=== HPV Table ===\n")
cat("Rows in table:", nrow(hpv_data), "\n")
cat("OCSCC patients matched:", nrow(hpv_ocscc), "of", length(ocscc_patient_ids), "\n")
print(table(hpv_ocscc$Final_HPV_Status, useNA = "ifany"))
```


```{r cleanup_and_session_info}
rm(clinical_ocscc, rna_se, rna_meta, mirna_counts, mirna_meta, maf_obj,
   hpv_data, hpv_ocscc, paired)
invisible(gc())
stop_log()
```
